game_title: Call Stack Tower – Skating Pond Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Skating Pond, a frozen skating pond: the firewood keeper must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Skating Pond: a frozen skating pond
core_gameplay_loop: In Skating Pond, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round, frost imps strike the chapel bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the chapel bell from frost imps in Skating Pond: keep the stack_height meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: stack_height drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
